specs.Item Type Name: Insta360 Luna Ultra Creator Bundle (Cosmic Black)

features: 8K CINEMATIC VIDEO QUALITY – Capture ultra-detailed 8K/30fps footage with a large 1-inch sensor, Leica optics, Dolby Vision HDR, and 10-bit I-Log for professional color grading.
DUAL-LENS LEICA SYSTEM – Switch seamlessly between the 20mm main lens and telephoto lens with up to 6x lossless and 12x hybrid zoom for versatile shooting.
DETACHABLE OLED TOUCHSCREEN – Control and monitor your shots remotely using the industry-first detachable 2-inch OLED display for flexible solo content creation.
ADVANCED AI TRACKING & STABILIZATION – Deep Track AI, 3-axis gimbal stabilization, and intelligent shooting modes deliver smooth, professional-looking footage in any scenario.
CREATOR BUNDLE ACCESSORIES INCLUDED – Comes with Insta360 Mic Pro transmitter, Battery Handle, Wide-Angle Lens, and Carry Bag for a complete content creation setup.
